newsitem.title: USA: Gold Banc to acquire Farmers Bancshares.
newsitem.headline: Gold Banc to acquire Farmers Bancshares.

text.p: Gold Banc Corp said Monday it has signed a definitive merger agreement to acquire Farmers Bancshares Inc in a transaction valued at $5.6 million.
Farmers is an Oberlin, Kan.-based company whose Farmers National Bank subsidiary had total assets of $55.6 million as of December 31.
The deal is expected to be accretive to Gold Banc's earnings in 1998 and is set to close in the fourth quarter of 1997, Gold Banc said.

The exchange ratio of the merger is fixed at 7.5 shares of Gold Banc common stock for those shares of Farmers' common stock outstanding which are not held by Farmers' employee stock ownership plan, plus a total cash consideration of $1.96 million, Gold Banc said.
The merger must be approved by Farmers' shareholders and by the appropriate federal regulatory agencies.
Gold Banc shares were up 3/8 at 15-3/8 Monday.
